summary.cumulativeRule: For each textbook, all reviewed allowedWords from earlier grades are preloaded; within the current grade, add the current section immediately before auditing it and never add later sections.

semantics.EXACT_ALLOWED: explicitly reviewed in current passage allowedWords
semantics.CUMULATIVE_ALLOWED: explicitly reviewed in an earlier grade or earlier/equal section of the same textbook; future sections excluded
semantics.FUNCTION_TO_GRAMMAR: vocabulary exemption only; must pass chronological grammar gate
semantics.MORPHOLOGY_TO_GRAMMAR: base appears in current/prior reviewed allowedWords; inflection/possessive still requires grammar chronology check
semantics.V7_LOOKUP_REQUIRED: still unresolved after prior-grade + current/prior-section app-reviewed vocabulary; must be checked against canonical v7 at exact section cutoff
